story_so_far: Day 1: Hamid (Lahore) got 82% in 12th but the university fee is Rs 2,00,000 a year; Abbu quietly said mubarak (rent is due). He tore the admission form and wrote PLAN B. Day 2: first job at a chai dhaba, 6 AM to 6 PM; burned his hand on the kettle and broke a cup, so Ustad ji paid Rs 450 instead of 500 (Rs 1,200 now). Bilal arrived with a 'paise double' scheme; Hamid doubts it. Diary: 'Aaj bhi bach gaye. Kal: Bilal ki scheme?!'
